summary: Iter 56 review — backend + frontend validation. Ran 65 backend tests total (iter53 refactor regression 18, iter53 endpoint coverage 20, iter54 tavily parser 5, iter55 duplicate+SMS 12, iter56 AI symbols 7, iter56 HTTP endpoints 6). 64 passed, 1 skipped (expected — Stripe seed-guarded), 0 failed. Verified new HTTP contracts: POST /takeoffs/{id}/analyze returns dimension_lines/wall_types/materials_notes/openings.reservations_visible; POST /takeoffs/{id}/duplicate returns new plan_id + filename with '(copie)'; POST /prices/alerts rejects sms without phone (422) and accepts email+sms with phone (200); POST /prices/search returns mode='web' from Tavily with checked_at on each row. Frontend /prix?q=BA13+hydrofuge shows 10 freshness badges (data-testid=price-freshness-<supplier>), SMS toggle (alert-sms-toggle) and conditional phone input (alert-sms-phone) — all working. Bundle.js confirmed to contain drawDimLine, LIVE AREA, tool-lock, plan-duplicate-btn, tool-rotate, tool-room, tool-polyline, alert-sms-toggle, price-freshness. Note: on first Tavily call there was a transient 'mode=demo' fallback; on retry it returned mode='web' correctly — Tavily degrades gracefully to demo when API is unreachable.

issues: allPlans state is loaded via loadAllPlans() but never rendered as a selectable list on the /plan landing view — user must re-upload or use MultiPlanDialog to see existing plans. This limits ability to reopen a saved plan directly from /plan. New iter56 buttons (tool-lock, plan-duplicate-btn) only appear once a plan is loaded, so this UX gap indirectly blocks their discoverability. Recommendation to E1: add a 'Mes plans récents' list on /plan idle state.

action_items: (P3 UX) Add a 'Mes plans' list on /plan idle screen so users can reopen existing takeoffs and access the new Lock/Duplicate buttons without uploading again.
critical_code_review_comments: engines/plan_ai.py PROMPT correctly includes 'traits de cote', 'porteur', 'cloison', 'doublage', 'hachures', 'trémie', 'materials_notes', 'text_verbatim' — normalizer defaults dimension_lines=[], wall_types={}, materials_notes=[], openings.reservations_visible=0 (all covered by unit tests).

engines/price_search.py: _pick_plausible_price correctly filters <3€ and >3000€, picks min plausible; mode='web' when Tavily returns hits, 'demo' fallback otherwise — Tavily is called with domain whitelist first, then unfiltered — good coverage.
routes/plans_crud.py _duplicate_filename handles no-ext / already-copie / empty cases idempotently (4 unit tests).
engines/alerting.py _send_sms degrades gracefully when Twilio env missing; _notify_channels dispatches email + SMS as expected (2 async tests via monkeypatch).
PlanTakeoff.jsx: tool-lock at L1661, plan-duplicate-btn at L1456, drawDimLine at L159, 'LIVE AREA readout' at L237 — all present in the served bundle.js (10.2 MB).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 3 verified surfaces (/prix badges + SMS, /plan buttons via bundle inspection)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin plans (>10 plans in /api/takeoffs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Combined pytest command: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter53_refactor_regression.py tests/test_iter53_endpoint_coverage.py tests/test_iter54_tavily_price_parser.py tests/test_iter55_duplicate_and_sms_alerts.py tests/test_iter56_ai_symbols_analysis.py tests/test_iter56_http_endpoints.py -v`. GET /api/takeoffs returns {plans: [...]}, not a bare list. Price search may transiently return mode='demo' if Tavily is rate-limited — retry once. To fully e2e-test tool-lock/plan-duplicate-btn/LIVE AREA in the DOM you must first upload a plan (no reopen-existing UI on /plan idle screen); the current test verifies presence in the JS bundle instead.
rca of the issue: No bugs. The 4 review-request features are implemented correctly. Only UX suggestion is adding a 'Mes plans' list on /plan idle state.
